spec.anchor: first M15 bar of each UTC calendar date (dt.dt.date groupby, .first())
spec.order_placed: at the day-open anchor bar s
spec.scan_window: bars s+1 .. min(s+96, n-1)  (96 M15 bars = 24h)
spec.first_trigger: first bar with high>=PDH or low<=PDL; opposite order cancelled on that bar
spec.entry_price: the activation level exactly (no gap adjustment)
spec.target: entry + dir * mult * risk, mult in {1.0,1.5,2.0}
spec.trigger_bar_resolution: resolution scan starts on the trigger bar itself
spec.expiry: unresolved at bar min(s+96,n-1) -> marked to market at that close
spec.cost: 0.419 price units per trade, converted to R as cost/risk
spec.episode_independence: one episode per UTC calendar date
spec.data: OANDA_XAUUSD_M15.csv full file, NO holdout truncation
